briefing_text: Executive Critical Advisory: Severe operational bottlenecks detected across lead response velocity and customer support ticket queues. Lead conversion has declined by -8.4% WoW down to 4.2%, primarily driven by 84 unassigned leads lingering beyond 48 hours without sales cadence outreach. Furthermore, Support SLA breach rate has spiked to 38.0% with 29 tickets stalled. Immediate executive intervention recommended across three automated recovery phases.

charts.title: Severe Funnel Leakage Breakdown
charts.description: Noticeable drop-off: 71% of captured leads stall prior to initial contact.

findings.title: Critical Lead Stagnation in Captured State
findings.evidence: 84 unassigned leads uncontacted for >48h. Conversion rate degraded to 4.2%.
findings.root_cause: SMTP outgoing mail service credentials missing or invalid, causing outreach agent pause.
findings.impact: Estimated revenue leakage of $45,000 in uncontacted pipeline opportunities.

findings.title: Support Queue SLA Breach Surge
findings.evidence: 38.0% of tickets breached 2-hour SLA window with 29 tickets stalled in pending_human.
findings.root_cause: Human escalations lack automated AI first-response deflection fallback.
findings.impact: Elevated churn risk across 14 high-tier enterprise clients.

improvement_plan.title: Configure Primary SMTP Relay and Auto-Dispatch Stalled Leads
improvement_plan.description: Establish verified SMTP channel and launch AI outreach re-engagement to all 84 stalled leads.
improvement_plan.estimated_roi: Immediate recovery of ~15 qualified meetings within 5 business days.

improvement_plan.title: Deploy Support AI Auto-Deflection for Level 1 Inquiries
improvement_plan.description: Activate Knowledge Base RAG auto-responder for incoming support tickets before human triage.
improvement_plan.estimated_roi: Cuts ticket SLA breach rate from 38.0% down to under 5.0%.
